displayName: Money Forward クラウド会計 MCP
description: Read and write Money Forward クラウド会計 books (offices, accounts, journals, trial balances, transition reports, bank and card transactions) through Money Forward's official MCP server. One multi-office API key covers every office it was issued for; each call names its office.

auth.label: Money Forward API キー
auth.placeholder: Paste the API key issued in the Money Forward app portal
auth.description: Issue it at https://app-portal.moneyforward.com → pick any office → APIキー管理 → 複数事業者 (or 単一事業者) → 新規登録, with the 事業者情報 and クラウド会計・確定申告 services. It is sent as the Mf-API-Key header and acts with your own permissions in each office. The key is shown only once; it can be revoked from the same screen of any office.

actions.name: current_office
actions.description: Get one office's name, type and accounting periods, newest first.

office_code.description: Office number (事業者番号, XXXX-XXXX) of the office to act on. Required on every call; there is no default office. Find it with get_accessible_offices.

outputSchema.description: JSON returned by the Money Forward Cloud Accounting MCP tool.

actions.name: get_reports_transition_balance_sheet

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year to report on. Defaults to the latest fiscal year.

start_month.description: First month of the fiscal year to include, used with fiscal_year.

end_month.description: Last month of the fiscal year to include, used with fiscal_year.

include_tax.description: Report tax-inclusive amounts. Only allowed when the office records amounts tax-exclusive.

with_sub_accounts.description: Include sub-account breakdowns under each account.

type.description: Aggregation unit. Only monthly is supported.

outputSchema.description: JSON returned by the Money Forward Cloud Accounting MCP tool.

actions.name: get_transactions
actions.description: List bank, card and other transactions (明細) collected from connected services, within a date range of at most 366 days.

office_code.description: Office number (事業者番号, XXXX-XXXX) of the office to act on. Required on every call; there is no default office. Find it with get_accessible_offices.

end_date.description: Last transaction date to include (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 366 days after start_date.

connected_account_id.description: Only transactions of this connected service. Do not combine with connected_sub_account_id.

connected_sub_account_id.description: Only transactions of this account within a connected service.

content_match_type.description: How content is matched. Ignored without content.

journalizing_statuses.description: Only transactions in these journalizing states. Omit for all.

side.description: Only income or only expense. Required when value_min or value_max is given.

value_min.description: Smallest amount in yen. Requires side.

value_max.description: Largest amount in yen. Requires side.

order.description: Sort by transaction date. Defaults to desc.

per_page.description: Transactions per page, 10 to 500. Defaults to 50.

outputSchema.description: JSON returned by the Money Forward Cloud Accounting MCP tool.

tax_id.description: Tax category ID (税区分), from get_taxes.

trade_partner_code.description: Business partner code (取引先コード), from get_trade_partners.
